conf.description: Facility SNMP APC/NMC management-card syslog direct route: hand-built RFC 3164 envelope + subsystem-tag split, PRI decomposed to facility/severity before rename, per recommendations.direct.cribl - no vendor pack or Elastic integration parses APC NMC event text

conf.comment: APC NMC2/NMC3 management-card syslog mirror of the card's internal event log. Splits the RFC 3164 header and the subsystem tag (TAG can contain spaces, so it is captured up to the first colon, never whitespace-split). recommendations.direct.cribl's Cribl-side scope is limited to the envelope/PRI/tag/HOSTNAME work - the per-event account-name/outcome extraction from MSG and the card-severity-to-event.severity mapping are both named only in the Elastic-side recommendation (grown grok patterns, per-site lookup), so they are NOT attempted here - documented gap, not an oversight. Some AOS versions omit HOSTNAME entirely, shifting field offsets for any positional parser (the work order's own caveat) - not compensated for. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, envelope approach, and the Cribl-vs-Elastic scope split for the free-text fields
split PRI, RFC3164 header timestamp, HOSTNAME (usually the card's own IP) and the subsystem TAG (APC/UPS/Environment/System/Automatic Transfer Switch) from the free-text MSG
decompose PRI into facility/severity codes (constraint: compute before rename) per the field's own transform instruction - divide by eight for facility, remainder for severity

batch-rename the three clean 1:1 envelope fields to their ECS targets; observer.hostname is usually an IP by card default and needs an inventory lookup to become a device identity, which no lookup data was supplied to build - carried through raw

best-effort RFC3164 timestamp parse into _time (never @timestamp, constraint 1) - no year/timezone in the source, reconciled against receiver arrival time only in the sense that Date.parse assumes the current year; facility cards are common NTP stragglers per the work order's own caveat
tag event.dataset (no hyphen, constraint 5) and event.provider (so this never double-counts against the snmp-trap route for the same card), and drop the consumed scratch envelope fields
